title: Testing strategy: decide and implement (resolving "testing is not happening")
objective: Define and implement an actual testing pipeline for little-mester — what gets tested, how tests run, and how the agent executes them during sessions.

subtickets.title: Add bats-core to agent Dockerfile
subtickets.objective: Install bats-core in agent image so `bats tests/` runs inside the container. If distro package missing, build from source.

subtickets.title: Implement MCP server tool tests
subtickets.objective: Create `tests/mcp-server.test.ts` with Jest tests for all 8 MCP tools (create, list, get, update, archive, search, board, validate). Test happy paths + error cases. Target: run via `npm test` in ticket-engine-mcp.

subtickets.title: Implement migration script tests
subtickets.objective: Test `src/migrate-tickets.ts` — MD→JSON conversion, schema validation, handling of edge cases (missing fields, malformed frontmatter).

subtickets.title: Wire run-tests.sh to run both engine + MCP tests
subtickets.objective: Ensure `./run-tests.sh` runs Jest tests for engine + MCP server, and bats tests for lab/container scripts.

subtickets.title: Add integration test: MCP server stdio transport
subtickets.objective: Test full MCP server lifecycle: start server via stdio, send JSON-RPC requests, verify responses. Use `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` test utilities.

notes: As of 2026-10-25: Engine tests (28 passing) exist in `little-mester-mcp/tests/engine.test.ts`. MCP server tests (32 passing) added in `little-mester-mcp/tests/mcp-server.test.ts` — subtask 2 complete. Missing: bats-core in container (subtask 1), migration tests (subtask 3), run-tests.sh wiring (subtask 4), integration tests (subtask 5). Per docs/DECISIONS.md C.1: testing is NOT happening because bats-core is not in the agent image and no Jest MCP test suite exists.
